notes.title: Second update - further balancing and some fixes
notes.notes: [p]Hello dear Metroloopers!  Second update brings changes to difficulty balance as well as it fixes some issues related with two enemies behaviour. Here is the list of all changes:[/p][list][*][p]Changes to weapons specs, increased accuracy of pistol, shotgun and machine gun among others[/p][/*][*][p]Difficulty curve related to amount of monsters on each station was changed in a way that it makes it easier on the begining and thougher further down the metro line[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed wasp and wolf AI that was stopping them at some point during game[/p][/*][*][p]Minor changes to other enemies parameters[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]THE NEXT STOP IS HELL - SEE YOU THERE![/p]

notes.title: First update now available!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Hello Metroloopers![/b][/h2]

The following changes took place in this first update after receiving initial feedback:
[list]
[*] Minor changes to balance of the game, especially initial stations
[*] Added killed monsters counter in the pause menu
[*] Version number added in main menu
[*] Possibility of exploiting previous save system to gain a lot of loot without going through stations was removed
[/list]

[h2][b]Please note:[/b][/h2]
Now, after resuming to the game you will have to pass at least one more station, before you can leave the game with saving.

I wish you happy survival and many stations passed safely!
Wacky Coati
